gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).
